name: devicely

tools.name: devicely_list_devices
tools.description: List all devices managed by Devicely (physical phones, Android emulators, iOS simulators), including platform, model, connection type, status, and whether agent control is allowed. Prefer calling this first to discover available device identifiers.

includeStopped.description: Whether to include stopped emulators and simulators in the list

tools.name: devicely_connect_device
tools.description: Initiate connection and start automation drivers (UIAutomator2 for Android, WebDriverAgent for iOS) on a target device. Idempotent: returns immediately if already connected. First-time iOS start may take 10-60s.

device.description: Target device name, serial, or UDID

tools.name: devicely_disconnect_device
tools.description: Disconnect automation driver sessions from a device. Safe and idempotent.

device.description: Target device name, serial, or UDID

tools.name: devicely_restart_device
tools.description: Reboot/restart connected mobile device(s). Destructive action gated by user policy. Use only when troubleshooting frozen system state.

devices.description: Target device name, serial, or UDID

tools.name: devicely_set_passcode
tools.description: Set the screen-lock passcode/PIN on connected devices (default: every online device). Android is set via adb and verified on the device. iOS cannot be set programmatically: those devices return NOT_SUPPORTED_ON_IOS with the manual Settings steps - do not try to work around it with taps.

anyOf.description: Target device name, serial, UDID, or selector ("all", "online", "commander", "followers")
Array of target device names, serials, or UDIDs

devices.description: Target device(s); defaults to "online" (all connected devices)

oldPasscode.description: Current PIN, required when the device already has a screen lock

tools.name: devicely_snapshot
tools.description: Capture device screen state. Returns a downscaled JPEG screenshot (image content) and/or pruned interactive UI element tree with stable references (e.g. e1, e2). Prefer this before acting. Use returned element refs or coordinates directly in devicely_tap.

device.description: Target device name, serial, or UDID

include.description: Components to capture: "image" (screenshot), "elements" (interactive UI tree), or both

interactiveOnly.description: Prune non-interactive containers to keep tokens minimal (default true)

query.description: Filter UI elements by text, ID, or label substring

maxElements.description: Maximum UI elements to return (capped at 500)

maxEdge.description: Maximum pixel dimension for screenshot long edge

query.description: Text, label, or resource ID to search for

instructions:
Devicely controls real iOS and Android devices. You plan the steps; Devicely has no AI of its own here.
Work in a loop: devicely_snapshot to read the screen, act (devicely_tap, devicely_type_text, devicely_swipe, devicely_launch_app, devicely_open_url, devicely_press_key), then snapshot again to confirm the result.
Read the state before tapping a toggle, so you never switch off something that is already on.
For a sequence you already know, send it in one devicely_run_commands call; use devicely_commander to mirror the commander onto followers.
A step reported as successful only means it was sent. Check the screen to know it worked.
